QuestInfo.name: A Way to Fight Off Sleep
QuestInfo.1:
I met with #b#p1040001##k.  #b#p1040001##k says he can't stand guard at the dungeon entrance because he keeps falling asleep.  If this continues, something bad is bound to happen.  I need to find a potion that can fight off sleepiness and give it to #b#p1040001##k.

#i02000000##t02000000# #b#c02000000#/1
#k#i02000001##t02000001# #b#c02000001#/1
#k#i02000002##t02000002# #b#c02000002#/1#k
#k#i02000003##t02000003# #b#c02000003#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: I fed the potion to #b#p1040001##k but it was no use.  But #b#p1040001##k was very appreciative of my efforts.

0.0: *Snore* Ahh! Was I dozing off again? I'm so tired these days, I can hardly stay awake at work. Stop looking at me like that. It's probably hard for you to understand but try staying under this warm sunlight all day...
0.1: I want to stop dozing off and do my job right, protecting this place, but I don't know how to keep myself from falling asleep. Do you think you can help me?

yes.0: Once #b#p1022000##k told me that if the mind and body are both healthy, they can fight off sleep. I guess I should be eating something that's good for my body but I don't know what to eat exactly.
yes.1: I trust you to discern and bring me things you think will be good for me. If you are a great adventurer, I'm sure you're familiar with various items and their effects.

no.0: You don't see the dungeon entrance? I have a sacred responsibility to protect this entrance. If I keep falling asleep, anyone will try to enter this dangerous place. Are you okay with that?

1.0: *Snore* Oh! It's you! You really must be a great adventurer. I didn't think you'd be back so soon. Why don't you start giving me one potion at a time? I'm sure I'll find one that will work.

yes.0: I've tried every single one of them... but I don't feel any different. Don't worry though. I won't forget everything you've done for me. Plus, you never know...
yes.1: Maybe the effects will kick in later. That's usually how medicine works, right? It's supposed to heal me right away? Haha! I don't know about that... It's not like this is a video game or something.

item.0: *Snore* Oh no! I fell asleep again. Hey, you didn't find me a cure yet?
